signIn.headline:
Learn it right.
Do it right. Every shift.
signIn.title: Sign in to ASAH Admin
signIn.sub: Use the phone number HQ registered for you.
signIn.notRegistered: This number is not registered. Ask HQ to add you.
signIn.wrongCode: That code did not work. Check it and try again.

shell.noAccessTitle: The admin web is for HQ and managers
shell.noAccessBody: Use the ASAH app on your phone for your tasks and learning.
shell.noProfile: Your account has no active profile yet. Ask HQ to set it up.

home.title: Welcome, {name}
home.subtitle: What would you like to work on?

checklists.title: Checklist templates
checklists.subtitle: The same builder makes opening and closing checklists, temperature and FIFO logs, prep lists, equipment logs and visit audits.
checklists.name: Name
checklists.kindRoutineHint: Filled by staff, scheduled per outlet and shift
checklists.kindAuditHint: Started by area managers on a visit
checklists.empty: No templates yet. Create the first one.

builder.auditSubtitle: Visit audit · started by area managers · findings become issues
builder.newVersionDone: Draft created. Publish it when ready.
builder.publishBody: Items are frozen once published. Runs created from tomorrow use this version.
builder.archived: Archived. No new runs will be created.
builder.failHint: A failed item (out of range, "no", or a missing required photo) raises an issue for the outlet manager. It escalates to the area manager after this deadline.
builder.frozen: Published items are frozen. Use "Edit items (new version)" to change them.
builder.addItem: Add item · yes/no, number, photo or note
builder.minMax: Min must be at most max
builder.noSchedule: Not scheduled. Add when and where it runs.
builder.scheduleHint: Runs are created each night. Staff get a reminder before the due time; the manager is alerted when one is missed.
builder.proofCamera: Photos from the in-app camera only
builder.proofPlace: Submit only inside the outlet area
builder.name: Name

org.title: Positions and levels
org.subtitle: Department is the career track, position is the job title, level is its step on the ladder. Changes apply without an app release.
org.levelHint: One active position per level in a department. Level decides mentor eligibility, not access.
org.empty: No departments yet. Add the first career track.

outlets.title: Outlets
outlets.subtitle: Brands, areas and outlets. An outlet's location and radius decide where its checklists can be submitted.
outlets.name: Name
outlets.locationHint: Copy the coordinates from Google Maps: right-click the outlet and click the numbers at the top.
outlets.needBrandArea: Add a brand and an area first.
outlets.bothOrNone: Fill in both latitude and longitude

users.title: Users and roles
users.subtitle: Position and level describe the job. Roles decide what someone can do in ASAH. New users get only the Staff role at their outlet.
users.createHint: They sign in with this phone number. The learning path of their position is assigned automatically.
users.editHint: Changing position assigns the new learning path. Changing outlet ends current mentorships.
users.deactivateBody: They lose access at once. Their roles are removed and their mentorships end. Their records stay.
users.noRoles: No roles. This person cannot do anything in ASAH yet.
users.auditNote: Every change is written to the audit log.
users.importHelp: Save the sheet as CSV with the columns name, phone, outlet, position, first_day (YYYY-MM-DD). Outlet and position must match the names in ASAH.
users.missingColumns: The file needs at least name and phone columns.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.subtitle: A role is a named bundle of permissions. Each permission is one action on one kind of record. A new user has only the Staff role; nothing is granted by default.
roles.name: Name
roles.description: What it is for, and the scope to grant it at
roles.deleteBody: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody holds this role.} =1 {1 grant will be removed: that person loses these permissions.} other {# grants will be removed: those people lose these permissions.}}
roles.defaultHint: Default roles can be narrowed but not deleted.
roles.pick: Pick a role to see its permissions.

paths.title: Learning paths
paths.subtitle: One path per position. New hires, and anyone who changes position, get the path of their position automatically.
paths.noPositions: Add positions first, in Positions and levels.
paths.noPath: This position has no learning path yet.
paths.name: Name
paths.addTitle: Add a module to the path
paths.allAdded: Every module is already in this path.
paths.addHint: Everyone in this position gets the module as soon as it is published.
paths.removeBody: People who already have this module keep it. New hires will not get it.

modules.title: Learning modules
modules.subtitle: Trainers write modules from videos, SOP cards and PDFs, with a quiz and a practical test. A training manager reviews and publishes them; authors cannot approve their own.
modules.ownModule: You wrote this version, so another reviewer must approve it.

builder.publishBody: Staff with this module open move to this version.
builder.publishRetraining: It is marked "retraining needed", so people who finished an earlier version get it again.
builder.retrainingHint: People who finished an earlier version get this one again when it is published.
builder.positionsHint: Who the module is for. Add it to a learning path to assign it.
builder.noContent: No content yet. Add videos, SOP cards and PDFs in the order staff should see them.
builder.uploaded: Uploaded. Cloudflare is processing the video.
builder.noQuiz: No quiz. Add one to check understanding: multiple choice, graded on the server, staff never see the answers.
builder.bankEmpty: No other questions in the bank yet.
builder.question: Question
builder.answersHint: Pick the correct answer. Questions are shared in the bank, so editing one changes it everywhere it is used.
builder.noRubric: No practical test. Add rubric lines and the trainee records a video in the app; their mentor scores each line pass or redo.
builder.rubricSummary: {count} rubric lines · recorded in the app · scored by the mentor
builder.locked: This version is {status} and cannot be edited.
builder.lockedPublished: Published versions are frozen. Create a new version to change the content.

dashboard.noOutlets: No outlets in your scope yet.
dashboard.modulesOverdue: {count, plural, =1 {1 module overdue} other {# modules overdue}}
dashboard.behind: {count, plural, =1 {1 trainee behind} other {# trainees behind}}

issues.title: Issues and audits
issues.subtitle: Problems from failed checklist items, audits and staff reports, with an owner and a deadline. Fixes are made and photographed on the phone.
issues.ownFix: You fixed this, so someone else has to check it.
issues.fixOnPhone: The owner marks it fixed with a proof photo in the ASAH app.
issues.auditsEmpty: No visit audits yet. Area managers start them from the app.

ratings.title: Mentor ratings
ratings.subtitle: Trainees rate their mentor anonymously when the mentorship ends. Mentors only see an average after enough ratings.
ratings.warning: Opening a mentor's ratings shows who rated them. Every view is written to the access log with your name.
ratings.average: Average {avg} from {count, plural, =1 {1 rating} other {# ratings}}

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.subtitle: Every admin and permission change: who, what, when, before and after.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Rules the database applies everywhere. Changes are logged.
settings.pathComplete: Mentor must have finished their own mandatory modules
settings.ratingMin: Ratings needed before a mentor sees their average
settings.certDays: Remind staff this many days before a certificate expires
settings.geofence: Only accept checklists submitted inside the outlet area
settings.geofenceHint: Turn off only for testing. Every outlet needs a location and radius.
